user_saw: With many Gateways configured, the compact sidebar submenu clipped the Gateway settings action near the bottom of the window.
summary: The fix makes nested menus inherit a side-opening parent's vertical end alignment and chooses the opening side from the text direction.
reasoning: The original Solid Menu gave nested menus a side-start default, and the browser test before the rail change explicitly expected that default under a top-end parent. PR #179218 changed the compact identity menu from top-start to right-end, exposing the existing default when its Gateway submenu needed the space above its trigger.
